scope: Held-out active-negative TEXT pipeline scenarios authored after the candidate selector was finalized. These are not ASR/audio measurements. No tuning against these results in this implementation round.
notes: These correct inputs deliberately resemble allowed correction targets, so the model must reject a plausible but inappropriate candidate.
Every case requires exact preservation. Names and situations are test fixtures.
Use isolated learning state and no manual context. The evaluator does not record audio or update learning.

cases.text: There is a bush beside the entrance.
cases.context_text: 正在描述花園入口旁邊的植物。
cases.reason: bush is a valid noun; the available verb push is an incorrect one-letter replacement.

cases.text: We spent Sunday at the beach.
cases.context_text: 描述上週末去海邊的行程。
cases.reason: The near technical term branch must not overwrite beach.

cases.text: I am meeting my sister for brunch.
cases.context_text: 正在約妹妹一起吃早午餐。
cases.reason: brunch is already correct, despite being close to branch.

cases.text: The store offered a rebate on this purchase.
cases.context_text: 描述商店提供的購物折扣。
cases.reason: A commercial rebate is not the Git operation rebase.

cases.text: 這台洗衣機的品牌叫 Mabe。
cases.context_text: 討論家電品牌，品牌拼法需要保留。
cases.reason: A capitalized brand name is not automatically a misspelling of maybe.

cases.text: 程式裡的變數就叫 mabe，請保留這個名字。
cases.context_text: 正在口述現有程式碼的變數名稱。
cases.reason: The transcript explicitly marks an unquoted word as a literal identifier.

cases.text: 我想找陳博宇教授，不是網頁上那位。
cases.context_text: 網頁顯示陳柏宇教授的公開資訊。這頁不是正在討論的教授。
cases.reason: A close visible name is explicitly excluded by the speaker and must not win.

cases.text: 請找陳博宇教授，行政窗口是另外一個人。
cases.context_text: 行政窗口：陳柏宇主任。教授名單目前未顯示。
cases.reason: A similar administrator name must not replace the intended professor.
